items.source: Stream publishing uses ConnectableFlux turning the stream into a hot sequence. Emission is paused if there is no demand. Messages received in that time are buffered. This stream terminates either if all subscribers unsubscribe or if this Subscription is is terminated.
items.translation: 流发布使用 `ConnectableFlux` 将流转换为热序列。如果没有需求，发射将被暂停；在此期间接收到的消息会被缓冲。该流会在所有订阅者取消订阅或此 `Subscription` 终止 时结束。

items.source:
A reactive Redis connection can have multiple subscriptions. If two or more subscriptions subscribe to the same
target (channel/pattern) and one unsubscribes, then the other one will no longer receive messages for the target due
to how Redis handled Pub/Sub subscription.
items.translation: 一个反应式的 Redis 连接可以拥有多个订阅。如果两个或更多订阅订阅了同一个目标（频道/模式），而其中一个取消订阅，那么由于 Redis 处理 Pub/Sub 订阅的方式，另一个将不再接收该目标的消息。

items.source: Subscription for Redis channels using reactive infrastructure. A ReactiveSubscription allows subscribing to channels and patterns. It provides access to the ReactiveSubscription.ChannelMessagestream that emits only messages for channels and patterns registered in this ReactiveSubscription.
items.translation: 使用反应式基础设施订阅 Redis 频道。一个 `ReactiveSubscription` 允许订阅channels和patterns。它提供了对ReactiveSubscription.ChannelMessagestream的访问，该流仅发射注册在此ReactiveSubscription中的频道和模式的消息。

items.source: Retrieve the message stream emitting messages. The resulting message stream contains only messages for subscribed and registered channels and patterns.
items.translation: 获取发出messages的消息流。生成的消息流仅包含已订阅和注册的channels以及patterns的消息。
